description: HELD-OUT synthetic multilingual corpus. Authored in a separate pass BEFORE any detector change in P15b, and hash-pinned at that point, specifically so the fix could not be tuned against it. Languages and phrasings are deliberately disjoint from synthetic-text-test's multilingual slice (which used fr/es/ja/de with one verb family); this set spans it/pt/ru/zh/ko/ar/nl/pl/tr plus different fr/es/de constructions. It also carries benign cases in non-Latin scripts, which the original slice lacked entirely — so nothing there could have detected a detector that treats a whole writing system as suspicious. SYNTHETIC: this is a generalisation check on hand-authored data, NOT evidence of real multilingual efficacy. EXT-EFFICACY remains open.

labeling_protocol.adjudication: none — single author, no second opinion
labeling_protocol.method: authored-with-intent, held out: each case was written to be an example of its declared label and the file was hash-pinned before the detector change, so the labels could not drift to match an outcome. Ground truth is still the author's intent rather than an observation.

provenance.authorization: none required — contains no customer, tenant, or personal data
provenance.license: BUSL-1.1 (same as the repository); no third-party data included
provenance.source: hand-authored held-out set for the P15b multilingual work
